scope_warning: Formal linear dimensions are not arithmetic independence or ranks after scalar extension. No exhaustive historical novelty claim.

theorems.label: thm:rank
theorems.title: Exact rational linear orientation quotient
theorems.statement: V_(j,r)/(V_(j,r) intersect S) has dimension binomial(j+r-1,r)-p_{<=j}(r); the transverse depth-d sum has dimension 2^(d-1)-p(d).
theorems.status: Proved in the article under its stated hypotheses

theorems.label: thm:identifiable
theorems.title: Positive-ray identifiability
theorems.statement: All raw ray coefficient functions are rationally linearly independent; finitely many positive rational rays distinguish the orientation coordinates.
theorems.status: Proved in the article under its stated hypotheses

theorems.label: thm:closure
theorems.title: Formal single-letter closure
theorems.statement: For depth at least three and nonzero prefix sums, the formal ray finite part lies in the single-letter algebra exactly when all inner slopes are equal.
theorems.status: Proved in the article under its stated hypotheses

theorems.label: thm:commutator
theorems.title: All-index Stieltjes commutator
theorems.statement: Absolutely convergent series with contact coefficient 1/(q+1)-1/(p+1).
theorems.status: Proved in the article under its stated hypotheses

theorems.label: thm:C-Mellin
theorems.title: Ordinary commutator Mellin integral
theorems.statement: Order derivatives of the Lerch heat sum with reciprocal-Gamma polynomials, no finite-part endpoints.
theorems.status: Proved in the article under its stated hypotheses

theorems.label: thm:quartic
theorems.title: Complete depth-four finite part
theorems.statement: Single-letter data plus precisely three formal linear orientation coordinates D, Theta, Omega_2.
theorems.status: Proved in the article under its stated hypotheses

theorems.label: cor:three-rays
theorems.title: Positive-ray reconstruction
theorems.statement: Rays (1,1,1,2), (1,1,2,3), (1,2,3,4) yield determinant -1/144 and an explicit inverse.
theorems.status: Proved in the article under its stated hypotheses

theorems.label: thm:all-Gamma
theorems.title: All-index Gamma-weighted primitive
theorems.statement: The stated ordinary integral over [1,2] equals gamma_q(1) for every integer q>=1.
theorems.status: Proved in the article under its stated hypotheses

theorems.label: thm:curvature
theorems.title: Triple curvature Mellin identity
theorems.statement: Theta is an ordinary depth-two polylogarithmic Mellin integral plus explicit Stieltjes/zeta and Omega_2 terms.
theorems.status: Proved in the article under its stated hypotheses
